title: Chapter 724
text:
"Bro, are you here yet?"

"Soon, soon."

A small spaceship was parked on the gray barren land. Summer Night Flower and the others waited beside the spaceship, either sitting or standing, for the buyer to arrive.

Very soon, another spaceship landed beside them. The buyer walked out of the spaceship, glanced around, and greeted Summer Night Flower.

"Where's the goods?" Summer Night Flower greeted.

"Where's the money?" The buyer was wary.

"Didn't I already transfer the money?" Summer Night Flower had a helpless expression.

"Ha, I was just playing up the atmosphere of a mafia deal. Don't you think it's very interesting?"

The buyer laughed. Seeing Summer Night Flower's expressionless face, he could only keep his smile and bring him into the cabin to look at the goods.

"Here, these are all the things you want. Check them. Don't say that I scammed you."

Summer Night Flower glanced at them and calculated in his heart before saying, "No need to check. I trust you."

This time, the buyer rubbed his hands, a little embarrassed, and said, "Say, we've known each other for a few years. We're very close, right?"

Summer Night Flower was a little confused. "What do you want to say?"

"I'm just asking you if we're friends who play together."

"What?"

"Since we're friends, can you sacrifice yourself and let me kill you a few times to earn some bounty?" The buyer's tone was careful. "Since you guys won't be able to get the bounty from the army, I can split the bounty 30-70 with you guys. Instead of benefiting others, why don't you let me have some meat and treat it as helping me solve my needs?"

"F * ck off." Summer Night Flower was speechless.

You want a 30-70 split? Do you think that little bit of bounty reward can make up for the experience lost from dying once?

Also, what do you mean by 'let you have some meat'? Do you think we're prostitutes?

"Stop talking nonsense. There's no problem with the goods. I'm taking them," Summer Night Flower said as he was about to pick up the equipment.

This time, the buyer suddenly grabbed his hand and chuckled. "No, I think it's better if you let me keep them for now."

"What do you mean? You want to go back on your word?" Summer Night Flower was furious. His companions around him had unfriendly expressions, and they surrounded him, looking like they were going to kill him and rob him.

The buyer did not panic at all. He said slowly, "I'm doing this for your own good. If you take the new equipment, you might be robbed later."

Summer Night Flower suddenly had a bad feeling.

At this moment, the sound of spaceships landing could be heard from outside. One after another, small spaceships landed on the ground, and a large group of players rushed out excitedly.

The expressions of Summer Night Flower and the others changed drastically. He didn't even need to think to know that this group of people were here for the bounty. He turned and glared at the person who had bought it, his face full of disbelief. "You actually betrayed me?!"

"See for yourself." The buyer curled his lips and took out his communicator. The location of Summer Night Flower's group was displayed on the communicator. Their coordinates were always being monitored, and this deal was no secret in the eyes of the nearby players.

"Why didn't I know?!" Summer Night Flower was dumbfounded. He suddenly remembered that his internal program of the army had been automatically uninstalled, and his heart was in pain.

The Philip subroutine of this group of players had been monitoring them in the background, controlling their coordinates and sending them to the nearby Black Star Corps members at any time. It was like constantly reminding the members of the army that the traitor was here, so go and play with him. Summer Night Flower and the others were like sheep in a pack of wolves, attracting attention, but they did not know anything about this.

Only the nearby players would know the coordinates. Summer Night Flower and the others had just arrived at Foothold 58 not long ago, so only the players at Perimeter 027 knew the coordinates. They thought that this was a mission notification and were used to it. No one posted on the forums, so Summer Night Flower and the others were kept in the dark.

Suddenly, Summer Night Flower realized something, and his face was filled with shock. "Wait, you knew that our coordinates were exposed, but you didn't tell me and didn't cancel the deal?"

"… Sorry, I'm a police officer."

"Speak human language!"

The buyer smiled shyly and said, "Sigh, I have to make a living. Since you guys are already here, it would be a waste not to kill you. So, instead of letting others take advantage of you, why not let me take the bounty? I'll give you guys a thirty-seventy split."

Summer Night Flower's lips trembled, and he could not say anything. He felt like he had just swallowed two kilograms of hot sh * t and was choking on it.

Good lad, you had bad intentions from the start!

This is a f * cking trap!

I treat you as a friend, and you want to mess with me?

The moral degeneration of the world was getting worse with each passing day. Where was the most basic trust between people?!

If the angry gazes of the Klent camp players turned into knives, they would be able to cut Summer Night Flower into a thousand pieces.

Looking at the rapidly approaching players, Summer Night Flower's face was filled with grief and indignation. He suddenly raised his hand, and the buyer thought that he was going to fight out of humiliation. He quickly jumped back a few meters, but he saw Summer Night Flower standing where he was and raising four fingers.

"Sixty-four!"

The buyer's eyes lit up. Like a butcher sharpening his knife, he reminded kindly, "Remember to choose the resurrection point of your camp when you revive. Otherwise, you'll be killed again."

"Thank you so f * cking much!" The sound of Summer Night Flowers gnashing his teeth was like grinding metal with a steel plate. His grief and indignation were filled with helplessness, helplessness, and heartache. His heartache was filled with compromises, and he was full of complaints against this society.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

A familiar white light flashed.

Summer Night Flower's vision blurred, and he was already back at Foothold 58. His face was bitter, and his heart was even more bitter.

I'm so tired. If I knew this would happen, I wouldn't have come to Klent …

This thought appeared in Summer Night Flower's mind, but he quickly dismissed it. He took a few deep breaths to calm himself down and convince himself to believe in his speculation.

Although the path was full of twists and turns, he still believed that the future of the Klent camp was bright.

I'll definitely be able to earn back the losses I've suffered now. Summer Night Flower cheered himself on and then left the resurrection point. He did not want to become a rabbit that would be used to wipe Black Bear's butt or be used by his revived companions to vent their anger.

This time, a friend message popped up on the interface. It was a message from the buyer.

"Leave your goods with me for now. Find a time to meet again. Let's meet again next time."

Summer Night Flower was so angry that his nose was about to become crooked.

Meet with you monkey? This is a trap! Do you want to screw me over again?!

"F * ck off! Refund the money! "

…

Han Xiao also saw this small disturbance among the players on the forums. A player posted a post to show off that he had killed the traitor first. He felt that it was worth praising and used the faction interface to transfer a lot of Enas and Experience to the player.

Summer Night Flower's analysis post was pushed to the top again, and many people mocked him. Summer Night Flower defended himself, saying that it was not a big deal that he was killed, and that it was just a normal faction battle. The storyline would prove that he was right in the future. This was very Kong Yiji.

A day later, Rexson gathered his troops and attacked Stronghold 58 in a grandiose manner.

With Han Xiao's current experience, this kind of small galactic battle of a single foothold was very common. The fleets of both sides tested each other, shot at each other, contacted, and killed. He did not need to observe the battle to know that this was the working process.

The fleets were fighting fiercely. Han Xiao had been observing from the flagship and did not interfere. He also did not let Hella and Fu Ding, the two Calamity Grades beside him, participate in the battle. Seeing that there were countless casualties on both sides, he then looked at Hella beside him.

"Try the effect of absorbing the souls of the dead on the battlefield."

Hella nodded. Her eyes slightly closed, and a red light flashed in them. Then, a thick black and red energy spread all over her body. It was as if her body had grown twenty centimeters taller. Her aura was hundreds of meters tall, cold, vast, and solemn, like an ancient god.

In the vast galactic battlefield, in the countless spaceship wreckages floating in space, a gray aura appeared, forming countless gray snakes that spanned thousands of kilometers and gathered in Hila's hand like a whale swallowing a rainbow.

The remaining mental energy of all the soldiers who died on the battlefield was absorbed by her.

Hella let out a breath like an arrow. She clenched her fists and said, "The strength and range of my Esper Ability have both increased. It's at least equivalent to half a year of my ability development."

"It's good that it's effective." Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed. This was good news. The faster Hella formed, the sooner she could help him suppress the situation. He could let Hella help him deal with some unimportant enemies.

Hella's unique shortcut method, he decided to call it picking up gray souls. Its nature was like the Dark North Divine Art, draining others dry and accumulating internal energy. It was also a cheat.

Right at this time, an abnormal energy suddenly erupted in the middle of the battlefield. Three Calamity Grades flew out from the fleet of Foothold 58. The intervention of high-level combatants immediately broke the balance of the battle strength, becoming a point that Rexson's troops could not handle. They were originally at a small disadvantage, but now, they were forced to retreat.

"Why are there three Calamity Grades? According to the intelligence, there's only Manudo! "In the flagship, the adjutant's face was filled with shock.

However, not only did Rexson not panic, he even laughed.

"Three is useless. With Black Star here, not to mention three Calamity Grades, even if there are thirty …" Rexson paused. Although he was very confident in Han Xiao, he still did not dare to flatter him too much. He coughed and changed his words. "Even if there are thirteen, His Excellency Black Star will still kill them. They will only help us increase our achievements."

Right at this time, the view window of the flagship zoomed in and focused on Manudo.

Manudo made a provocative gesture at the flagship. Then, the flagship received a video message from Manudo. His pale face appeared on the screen. His forehead was covered in cold sweat, and his arrogant expression looked very awkward.

"Black Star! I know you're inside. Don't hide. I'm not afraid of you. The three of us Grade A Supers are challenging you here at the same time. Do you dare accept? Ha, ha, ha! "

At the end, Manudo laughed stiffly three times. Cold sweat rolled down his face. If one looked closely, one could see that his face was twitching non-stop as if he was about to cry. It was as if he was barely able to maintain his fierce expression.

The people in the command room of the flagship had strange expressions.

Although the enemy was threatening them, why did it feel like they did not have much confidence?

Han Xiao facepalmed. Using such lousy acting skills to provoke me, are you serious?

Rexson turned to look at Han Xiao and said respectfully, "Your Excellency Black Star, we are unable to deal with a Calamity Grade Super. Please help us."

The way he saw it, it would be a piece of cake for Han Xiao to kill three normal Calamity Grade Supers.

However, Han Xiao shook his head and patted Hella's slender waist. "I'll leave these three to you."

Facing three opponents of the same level alone, Hella did not show any hesitation. She turned around and prepared to fight. She was not someone who was afraid of difficulties; she liked to face them head-on. Since Han Xiao could deal with multiple opponents of the same level, Hella treated him as her goal and had high standards for herself.

Furthermore, she also wanted to fight a strong enemy to the death under enough pressure to test her actual combat ability among the Calamity Grade Supers.

Manudo and the other two attacked the battleship while waiting for Han Xiao to fight. To Manudo, every second was torture. It was as if he had stepped onto the execution ground and was just waiting for the guillotine to fall. If not for Joad's order, he would have turned around and run.

Joad was also observing the battle through the remote video, waiting for Han Xiao to make a move.

This time, a dark red meteor appeared in their vision. It was extremely fast and crashed toward them without saying anything. A Grade A Cannon Master beside Manudo opened fire from afar, and high-energy particle beams bombarded the dark red meteor, slowly reducing its speed.

However, the next moment, this cluster of dark red meteors suddenly exploded, releasing thousands of red energy beams that seemed to cover half of the battlefield. The energy level was extremely thick and dense. Like a thousand giant pythons, they crashed into the Bloodshed Land fleet and swung their heads crazily like whips, executing an AOE attack.

Manudo and the other two were also swept by the dozens of red energy beams that were almost solid. Apart from carrying the usual energy attacks such as heat and explosion, Hila's energy beams also shocked the three of them mentally. They felt their hearts palpitate and hurriedly backed off in shock.

"This energy is so strange."

"Just now, this energy beam was like a hand with suction cups, trying to suck away my mental state."

After the tsunami-like red energy was released, Hella's figure was revealed. The black and red armor on her body was lightweight and focused on increasing energy release. She did not have a helmet but a transparent energy membrane that covered her head. It had an internal life support system and a wide field of vision.

Manudo was surprised. He had thought that it would be Black Star. Who was this woman?

"Is there such a person in the Black Star Corps?"

"The intelligence did not show it. Is she a new officer who joined recently?"

"She's very strong. I feel a threat from her."

The three of them chatted in the communication channel and all felt the pressure.

Joad, who was watching the battle remotely, was also confused. He sized up Hella carefully. He had never seen this person before. Black Star had actually sent her to fight three Calamity Grade Supers alone. Did he believe in her strength?

"The Black Star Corps is really full of talents."

Joad clenched his teeth. Seeing that Black Star was not attacking, he had no clue either. He could only signal Manudo and the others to fight Hella to find out more.

At the same time, the others on the battlefield also noticed the confrontation between the high-level combatants.

The participating Black Star Corps players saw Hella's appearance clearly and were shocked.

"Hey, this beauty looks a little familiar."

"I remember now. Isn't this Hella who appeared in Version 10 and Version 20? She's someone I know."

"Yes, it's her. I thought she was dead in Version 30. She's still alive and seems to have become very strong."

"She disappeared in the middle and late stages of Version 20. When did she join our army?"

"If I remember correctly, Black Star infiltrated the Germinal Organization in Version 10 to save her? She seems to be the army commander's old lover? "

"Oh …"
